purpose: scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs carries thirty credential rules and three privacy rules, and not one of them detects a payment card number. A payment provider is one of this repository's own declared Gate G0 blockers, so the first credential this repository is likely to meet in anger is the one class it cannot see. CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md forbids customer PII repository-wide with no carve-out; a primary account number is customer PII and a scanner that reports a Thai national identity number while ignoring a card number enforces that rule selectively.

include: One scan rule detecting a primary account number by Luhn checksum and issuer prefix together
RFC-2026-008 recording the decision, including why published provider test cards are reported rather than exempted
Test coverage in test-kits/secret-scan.test.mjs, including the false-positive cases the rule must NOT report
exclude: Any provider integration, sandbox credential or live key -- Gate G0 forbids all three
A card verification value rule: three digits carry no checksum and no prefix, so a rule for them reports noise and would be disabled
A Thai bank account number rule: the format carries no checksum this scanner can verify
Any change to what npm run check runs, or to any contract

amends_without_owning.rationale: WP-0A-A0-003 owns the scanner and its test; WP-0A-A0-002 owns the integrity manifest. This package adds one rule and its coverage, and updates the digests it necessarily invalidates. Declaring these as outputs made the ownership validator exit 70, correctly: two packages cannot hold one path. The amendment is recorded on the owning manifests instead. The workflow and the manifests below were carried up the stack so every downstream pull request runs the same branch-scope step; .github/workflows/ci.yml belongs to WP-0A-A0-004 and each manifest to its own package. Removed 2 declaration(s) that explain nothing this package's own branch changed, named by deadAmendments and confirmed by git diff over e287ac6..WP-0A-A0-005-cardholder-data-scan: .github/workflows/ci.yml, work-packages/WP-0A-A0-004.json. Each was a standing permission over another package's files granted for work that never happened. REFRESH 2026-10-06: the four amendments this package made (scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs, test-kits/integrity-manifest.json, test-kits/secret-scan.test.mjs, work-packages/WP-0A-A0-003.json) reached main in PR #11 (merge eadd7d6, 2026-09-02) and stay recorded where they belong, as amended_by entries on WP-0A-A0-003.json and WP-0A-A0-002.json (recorded_on). They are removed from paths because this branch, refreshed from main e1fa28e, changes none of them: node scripts/verify-branch-scope.mjs origin/main WP-0A-A0-005 exited 74 naming all four as dead amendments, the same rule that removed two in 0c47050. A later increment of this package that touches one of those files must declare it again.

acceptance_criteria: A Luhn-valid card number carrying a recognised issuer prefix is reported, in prose and in code alike.
A Luhn-INVALID digit run of card length is not reported, so a correlation id or a hash prefix does not become a finding.
A Luhn-valid run with no recognised issuer prefix is not reported: one in ten arbitrary digit runs passes Luhn, and a rule that fires on those is noise.
A published provider test card IS reported. The scanner cannot distinguish a test number from a live one at rest, and Gate G0 permits no provider integration that would need one.
The rule is not prose-exempt, on the same footing as the Thai national identity rule.
Repository scan over the tree stays clean; npm run check stays green with no test skipped.
required_tests: Positive: each supported issuer family, hyphen- and space-separated forms
Negative: Luhn-invalid runs, repeated-digit fillers, unrecognised prefixes, and adjacent-digit boundaries
The published provider test card is reported
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One scan rule and its tests; no persisted data, provider state, credential, migration or customer-data effect.
open_blockers: No role verdict exists for this package at any head. The independent security review and independent testing that corrected the rule in 2026-08/09 are recorded only inside the Author's own evidence/WP-0A-A0-005/author-self-check.md; there is no C0, A1, Q0 or R0 file under evidence/WP-0A-A0-005/. All four first role verdicts are owed at the current main: Reviewer /claude/c0_contract_reviewer, Security /claude/a1_bastion, Tester /claude/q0_sentinel, Integration Owner /claude/r0_steward. Until they exist this package stays in_review (evidence/WP-0A-A0-005/author-reverify-2026-10-06.md).

The status field and the tree disagree. The rule, its tests and RFC-2026-008 reached main through PR #11 (merge eadd7d6) while this manifest still reads in_review. That merge predates RFC-2026-025 and carries no role signature of this package; the Integration Owner disposes of it, not the Author.

The two acknowledgements this package needs are recorded against the wrong run. WP-0A-A0-003.json ownership.amended_by[0] and WP-0A-A0-002.json ownership.amended_by[0] (both WP-0A-A0-005 amendments) name acknowledgement_required_from: /claude/a0_atlas, which is the Author of this package. An Author cannot acknowledge its own amendment. Both owning packages name /claude/r0_steward as Integration Owner, so that is the run the field should name. Both records are outside this package's writable paths: owed by the owners of WP-0A-A0-003 and WP-0A-A0-002 (correct the field), then by /claude/r0_steward (record the acknowledgement). Both stay acknowledgement_status: pending.
A pattern scanner cannot prove absence. This closes one named class; it does not make the scanner complete, and the 37 of 56 uncorrelated decoys recorded against WP-0A-A0-003 remain unreported.

When a Stripe sandbox is authorized and a G0 blocker lifts, fixture work may legitimately need a test card. That must arrive as a reviewed exemption with a named owner, not as an allowlist added quietly to this rule.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; this package is restricted to reversible, synthetic-only work.
